posts.name: Degala Leela Venkata Lokesh
posts.cooked:
I am unable to login to my course VM even after submitting the SSH key correctly.I have completed BPT1 successfully but due to this I am unable to complete my BPT2 . I have attached the screenshot of the issue ,kindly guide me for solving this issue.

Screenshot 2026-03-13 1836171460×718 19.6 KB

posts.name: Mrinal
posts.cooked: please try a different network. The VM is up and running, the problem is on the user side.

posts.name: ishu
posts.cooked:
I have tried the exact steps but not able to connect with VM
During ssh-keygen id_rsa.pub file is empty whereas there is another 2 files instead → id_ed246411.pub
The key in this file is shorter and fails to connect. Tried multiple times with different pc still no resolution.
Even asked IIT Support no resolution till yet.

image869×134 6.21 KB

posts.name: Gurkirat Singh
posts.cooked:
Mrinal.exe:

please try a different network. The VM is up and running, the problem is on the user side.

‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎

posts.name: ishu
posts.cooked: Thanks, it was literally due to the network. I have been using a proctored network and that might be stopping me to do so.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: On a different note. What is ed246411? Do you mean ed25519 ? If yes this is expected and current default algorithm for private public keypair generation.
